<Subject 2> is the younger man with short dark wavy hair, a tanned athletic build, and bright red swim trunks with yellow side stripes, appearing in <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the tropical beach environment at sunset, featuring a wide sandy shore, calm ocean waves, and silhouetted palm trees against an orange and purple sky, as shown in <Picture 3>.

detailed_description:
The target video has a romantic cinematic style with warm golden-hour lighting.
[Shot 1] A medium tracking shot follows <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> walking side-by-side along the wet sand of <Subject 3>, their bare feet leaving shallow imprints. The low sun casts long shadows across the beach. They stop near the water's edge and face one another. <Subject 1> (S1) looks into the younger man's eyes with a gentle expression and says, <d>[Dutch] Ik hou van je.</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:06.500, the camera pushes in to a close-up as <Subject 2> reaches out and firmly grasps <Subject 1>'s face with both hands. He tilts the older man's head slightly upward and kisses him on the mouth. The sunset glow reflects off the rippling water behind them.

Soft rhythmic waves of the ocean lapping against the sand and the sound of their bare feet walking on wet ground.

A gentle, romantic instrumental score featuring a solo piano with warm string swells, maintaining a slow tempo that resolves softly as the kiss begins.

# Reference-to-video - LightX2V

## Purpose
Generate video and audio guided by reference images, video or audio.

## Use
1. Load your reference media in the input nodes.
2. Write the scene, action and audio prompt.
3. Set output size, duration and seed, then run the workflow and review the result.

Workflow: lightx2v-r2v-pod.json
